summary.en: A browser-only Dou Dizhu (Fight the Landlord) with dealing, bidding, play hints and simple AI opponents.
summary.zh: 纯前端斗地主，含发牌、叫地主、出牌提示与简单 AI 出牌逻辑。

description.en: Seventeen cards in hand plus three bottom cards: bid to become the landlord, then shed your hand first to win the round. Singles, pairs, runs, bombs and other standard combos are all supported.
description.zh: 17 张手牌 + 3 张底牌，抢地主后先出完手牌者胜；支持单张、对子、顺子、炸弹等常规牌型。

howto.en: Mouse — click to select cards and play.

tip.en: Card games are the steadiest traffic category for Chinese audiences, and the front-end logic is complete — attach a room backend and it goes multiplayer. Keep it strictly entertainment; nothing involving real money.
tip.zh: 国内流量最稳的棋牌品类，前端逻辑完整，接后端房间即可做联机版。注意合规：仅作娱乐、不涉真钱。
